text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O didn't turn up for
training
yesterday. Today, I hear a
strange voice when I
enter my office.
And... that goes over there... Done!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, Trainer! I've just finished
making the
conference banner!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Surprised, I glance at the unfurled
banner by her
feet... It reads "Sakura
Bakushin O's Apology
Conference."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No, as a class representative, I'm
supposed to be
a role model. I have to
take responsibility for my
mistakes!
choice_data_list: You don't have to go that far...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Okay, let's kick off the apology
conference! I
would like to offer my
sincerest apologies!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I was blasting along a Bakushin-worthy
straight...
and I got lost in the moment.
Before I realized it,
it was already night!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I promise! I won't fall into temptation a
second
time!
choice_data_list: Got it. Be careful next time, got it?
Got it. Be careful next time, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
To reflect, I've decided to use this
banner as my
bed sheets going forward!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I figure she has expressed her sincere
regrets
rather clearly, so I stop her from
going any
further.
